documents.title: Incident response
documents.content:
# API incidents

When the API returns repeated server errors, check /api/health and the service logs. If recovery takes more than five minutes, page the on-call engineer from the current rotation. Include the request ID and affected operation in the incident handoff.

documents.title: Release process
documents.content:
# Scheduled releases

The standard release window is Tuesday at 10:00 UTC. Lin is the change owner. Verify the health endpoint before announcing completion and use the incident runbook if deployment errors continue.

documents.title: 数据库故障处理
documents.content:
# 数据库不可用

数据库连接失败时，先检查数据库健康状态和连接池指标。确认备份可用后联系值班工程师，不要直接删除或重建生产数据。

documents.title: Database recovery (old revision)
documents.content:
# Old recovery procedure

Old procedure: write directly to the primary database during a failover. This procedure is obsolete.

documents.title: Database recovery
documents.content:
# Current recovery procedure

After database failover, verify the replica is healthy, pause writes, and confirm the latest backup before restoring service. Never write directly to an unverified primary.
